page.overview:
What is Kinoko Islands?

The Kinoko Islands is a non-canon archipelago in the East Blue, located near the Gecko Islands. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!.

The Kinoko Islands are made up of four small islands, respectively known as the "West", "Left", "Right", and "East" islands (from left to right).

The archipelago is located roughly southeast of Syrup Village, between it and Pescatore Island.

The Kinoko Islands is home to the extremely rare Amanita Truffle.
